title: How to clean a keyboard

pieces.say: Flip your keyboard over. Seriously, do it.
pieces.text: Flip your keyboard over. Seriously, do it.
pieces.label: HIDDEN GRIME

pieces.say: Here's the hidden spot. Crumbs live under the keys.
Unplug it or switch it off.
Flip it over and tap out the crumbs.
Brush between the keys with a soft brush.
Wipe with a cloth barely damp with rubbing alcohol.
Never spray anything onto the keys. Damp cloth only.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
